final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: IREF into diode-connected NMOS
Mb1 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=2 L=1
* mirror branch to generate PMOS bias
Mb2 pb ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=1
Mb3 pb pb vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=1
* common-source gain stage with PMOS current-source load
Mp1 x pb vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=1
Mn1 x iin vss vss nfet W=8 L=0.5
* source-follower output buffer
Mn2 vdd x vout vss nfet W=4 L=0.15
Mb4 vout ibias vss vss nfet W=1.6 L=1
* feedback network
Rf vout iin 150000
Cf vout iin 2e-14
.ends dut
